subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about scaling installs for your casual and hypercasual portfolio without the cheap install that never opens twice. The one point worth repeating: we optimize toward the retained D7 user and model the cohort from real impression-level ad revenue, so the signal reflects monetization rather than a bare install ping. That is why the volume we buy still earns on rewarded and interstitials, holding around 95,000 installs a day at 23% D7 retention. Happy to share the retention curve behind that. Worth a quick look?
angle: warm bump, restate retained D7 user proof
illustrative_flags: 95,000 installs a day at 23% D7 retention (MobUpps, illustrative)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN gaming_casual_hypercasual: references prior outreach in first sentence; restates single proof (retained D7 user + ad-revenue-modeled cohort); one illustrative MobUpps figure (95k installs/day at 23% D7); soft CTA, 1 question mark; no sign-off; native register; no X-not-Y (states the positive).
